findings.one_line: The graph-edge-range clause is not consumed: the joint score-locality cylinder condition already makes every score (and hence all identification, concentration, unbiasedness, and minimax steps) radius-r local, so dropping the graph-neighbor restriction genuinely broadens the class without changing any reproduced argument.

cited_checks.note: The supplied Theorem 2 statement gives the zero-normalized-variance block-factor coboundary with an (ell-1)-block transfer and constant mu; centering converts mu to E[X_i], and its stated converse gives the iff used here.
The supplied First Pinsker inequality V(P,Q) <= sqrt(K(P,Q)/2) matches the node after the node's stated TV and KL notation expansion.
The supplied average-error identity is (1-TV)/2; multiplying by two yields exactly the node's sum-risk inequality for every binary test.
The supplied Lemma 1.2 conclusion exactly matches the node's two-sided bounded-differences tail inequality under the stated independent-coordinate and oscillation hypotheses.
